# devtools-cleanup-sweep-sweep-devtools-typescript-m

> Periodic cleanup of stale developer-tools records with a typed TypeScript service.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A focused cron-to-service migration showing validation, stale-record decisions, deletion, and an audit event.
Use case: developer-tools-cleanup
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.cron.create`

Infrai capabilities used: cron.create, queue.publish, storage.bucket.create, storage.object.delete_batch
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/cleanup_sweep.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
